hyps.why: Replacing none with conv3x3 restores connectivity as well as adding capacity, so the gain exceeds that from replacing any other op.
A direct 0->3 skip already provides a strong signal and gradient path, making an extra late conv partly redundant.
One strong conv per path is largely sufficient, so a second conv on the same chain saturates.
Pooling after a rich conv feeder acts as a regularizing aggregator instead of discarding weak features.
With a skip on 0->3 carrying the signal, the 0->1->2->3 chain contributes less marginal value.
Consecutive parameter-free pooling over-smooths features and removes useful detail.
A 1x1 conv can mix channels from spatially rich upstream features, giving complementary value.
Replacing the weakest parameter-free op yields a bigger gain than replacing skip or conv1x1.
The skip shortcut already supplies the output with direct features, reducing the benefit of another conv into node 3.
A conv feeding a conv at the output node builds depth and receptive field on the main path, so the late conv compounds.
